title: Power Automate: time and cost savings rules for desktop flows
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly reports that neither savings setting has documented automation. Microsoft documents writable Dataverse Organization properties for money-saving permission and savings-record retention. The roadmap facts and the distinction between desktop-flow plans and cloud-flow documentation are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page describing these desktop flow savings rules at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "rules" default enable prerequisites. Opened power-automate/savings, settings-features, automation-center-overview and agent-flow-savings; none describes desktop savings rules.

claims.claim: The cited Power Automate savings documentation describes savings rules for cloud flows.
claims.quote: The savings feature provides a way to calculate how much time and/or money a cloud flow is saving to your organization. You can add a user-defined saving rule to each cloud flow, which generates savings at successful cloud flow runs.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents the savings-rule concept for agent flows as well.
claims.quote: The flow savings feature lets you calculate how much time and/or money an agent flow is saving your organization. You can add a user-defined saving rule to each flow, which keeps track of savings on successful flow runs.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agent-flow-savings to sources and cite it for the agent-flow concept and security-role requirement; that is the page supporting these statements.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a desktop-savings tenant-wide default beyond the roadmap's statement that it is not enabled automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings time-saving rules tenant default admin disable time savings storage permissions automation center delay. Opened settings-features and savings; no additional desktop-specific tenant default was stated.

claims.claim: Cloud-flow savings records are stored in the Dataverse Flow Aggregation table and have a retention setting.
claims.quote: Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity. Dataverse automatically deletes records that are older than the specified time frame.

claims.quote: Searched: desktop flow savings licensing pricing meter prerequisites saving rules. Read savings and agent-flow-savings in full: both state permissions requirements; neither names a licence or meter.

claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "rules" default enable prerequisites. Opened savings and agent-flow-savings; read desktop-flows/requirements search results. No desktop savings prerequisites found.

claims.claim: The automation center Savings page tracks cost savings and time saved.
claims.quote: The Savings page, located in the Value section, helps you quantify the return on investment (ROI) from your automation efforts by tracking cost savings, time saved, and efficiency gains.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not explicitly say whether desktop-flow savings appear on that Savings page.
claims.quote: Searched: desktop flows savings saving rules license prerequisites storage Flow Aggregation automation center. Opened automation-center-overview and savings; the Savings section links to cloud-flow documentation without naming desktop-flow savings.

claims.claim: The money-saving setting is in Power Platform admin center under Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... In the Manage pane, select Environments. ... On the Environments page, select an environment. ... In the command bar, select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Features.

claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for controlling whether makers can create money-saving rules.
claims.quote: ismoneysavingsallowed | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether the maker can create Power Automate money based saving rules.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api and its rendered gap with kind rest, call 'PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>)' with JSON body {"ismoneysavingsallowed":false}, Content-Type: application/json and If-Match: *, and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/organization. This disables permission to create Power Automate money-saving rules; retain the desktop-applicability qualification. Replace the corresponding no-API prose with 'Dataverse documents the Organization property ismoneysavingsallowed for money-saving permission.'

claims.claim: Disable money-saving rules is an environment setting documented for cloud flows, agent flows and agents.
claims.quote: When On, prevents makers from creating money-saving rules and tracking money savings generated by their Power Automate automations (cloud flows) and by their Microsoft Copilot Studio automations (agent flows and agents).

claims.claim: The Disable money-saving rules switch is Off by default.
claims.quote: Setting | Description | Default value ... Disable money-saving rules. ... | Off

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly confirmed the money-saving environment setting's applicability to desktop-flow savings.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings time-saving rules tenant default admin disable time savings storage permissions automation center delay. Opened settings-features, savings and Organization Web API reference; none explicitly includes desktop savings.

claims.claim: Savings-record retention is in Power Platform admin center under Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... In the Manage pane, select Environments. ... On the Environments page, select an environment. ... In the command bar, select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Features.

claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for savings-record retention.
claims.quote: savingeventsttlinminutes | Edm.Int32 | Default time to live in minutes for new Power Automate savings events records in flow aggregation.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api and its rendered gap with kind rest, call 'PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>)' with JSON body {"savingeventsttlinminutes":<minutes>}, Content-Type: application/json and If-Match: *, and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/organization. State that the API value is minutes and applies to new savings-event records, retaining the desktop-applicability qualification. Replace the corresponding no-API prose with 'Dataverse documents savingeventsttlinminutes on Organization for the default lifetime of new savings-event records.'

claims.claim: The retention setting is named Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity and governs records rather than rules.
claims.quote: Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity | Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity.

claims.claim: The savings-record retention setting defaults to 365 days.
claims.quote: Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity ... | 365 days

claims.claim: Agents' savings are not stored in Flow Aggregation and are not affected by its retention setting.
claims.quote: Agents' savings aren't stored using the Flow Aggregation entity and aren't impacted by this setting.

claims.claim: For agents, time savings can still be calculated when cost savings are disabled.
claims.quote: Makers can still calculate time savings with cost savings turned off.

claims.claim: The feature settings documentation does not list a separate time-savings switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings time-saving rules tenant default admin disable time savings storage permissions automation center delay. Read settings-features and analytics-cost-savings; no separate time-savings switch listed.

claims.claim: The roadmap record names no licence requirement, price or meter.
claims.quote: To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to inspect savings-table security-role privileges, but the controls table has no permissions row.
claims.quote: Confirm which security roles in your environments carry privileges on the Saving Rule and Flow Aggregation tables ... [The controls table contains only money-saving permission and savings-record retention settings.]
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Confirm which security roles in your environments carry privileges'. The factual cloud-flow permissions explanation can remain in Governance controls; do not add a control row as part of this correction.
